title: Create: AeroStar Northstar Comp
description: A fixed & expanded fork of the Create Northstar–Aeronautics compatibility mod: travel between planets and build space stations.
body:
# Create: AeroStar

**AeroStar** is a fixed and expanded continuation of the
[**Create: Northstar–Aeronautics Compatibility**](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-northstar-aeronautics-compatibility)
mod by **Vladi-YT-Dev**. It keeps the original idea — flying your **Create: Aeronautics**
physics ships to **Northstar**'s planets with a **Dimensional Drive** — but rebuilds the
dimension-travel core so your ship actually survives the trip, and adds new tools for
life in space.

> Use AeroStar **instead of** the original compatibility mod — don't run both at the same time.

## 🔧 What it fixes

The original had several problems when a ship changed dimension (a Sable sub-level being
re-created in another world). AeroStar fixes them:

- **Lost ship components** — redstone links, thruster/gimbal settings and control blocks
  no longer vanish on the jump. The block entities are now re-applied at the correct
  coordinates for the destination (accounting for its different build height), instead of
  landing in the wrong place and being dropped.
- **Getting kicked out of the seat** — you no longer pop out of your vehicle when you
  arrive or return. The seat is captured, recreated in the new dimension and you are
  re-mounted automatically.
- **Falling / no zero-gravity on arrival** — arriving in orbit no longer makes you drop
  like a rock.
- **Ship rocketing away or spinning on arrival** — the ship's velocity is reset on jump,
  so it settles instead of flinging itself across the world.

## ✨ What it adds

- **Real zero-gravity in orbit** — your ship floats freely in orbit, while you can still
  stand on the deck and walk around normally.
- **Engineer's goggles overlay** — look at the Dimensional Drive wearing Create's
  engineer's goggles (or the Aeronautics engineer helmet) to read the **destination**,
  **speed**, **current altitude** and the **altitude required** to launch.
- **Orbital Physics Assembler** — a new craftable variant of the Physics Assembler that
  can **assemble/disassemble far from the ground**, so you can build proper space
  stations in orbit (the normal assembler still refuses to disassemble mid-air).

## 🚀 How it works

Install the **Dimensional Drive** on a Create Aeronautics ship, insert a Northstar
**Star Map** to choose a planet (or leave it empty for Earth orbit; planets also need an
**Interplanetary Navigator** on the ship), then climb above the launch altitude. The
drive saves your whole ship (its Sable sub-level), re-creates it in the destination
dimension, carefully restores every block entity's data, brings your passengers and seat
along, and preserves momentum — so you arrive with the same working ship you left with.

## Requirements

Requires **Create**, **Create: Aeronautics** and **Northstar** (see Dependencies).

## Credits & License

AeroStar is a fork of **Create: Northstar–Aeronautics Compatibility** by **Vladi-YT-Dev**
(https://modrinth.com/mod/create-northstar-aeronautics-compatibility) and is released
